scope: Direct review of all four original images. Only the selected Shaw interior fills a required slot; rejected originals remain outside the collection.

items.title: Colossal Cave Adventure on VT100 terminal.jpg
items.reason: The original shows cyan/blue text with broad ambient room light on the cream case and bright tape rack. It does not establish the required green-phosphor terminal in a dark room with screen light confined to the desk.

items.title: Vt100-adventure.jpg
items.reason: The visible badge reads VT101 despite the file title. Blue/white text, ambient illumination of the cream case and the cropped keyboard do not establish the required green-phosphor VT100 dark-room/desk-spill treatment.

items.title: The Enchanting Shadow — HKFA 2
items.reason: The still shows a seated zither player, a candle held by the standing figure, dark patterned wall panels and lattice, and saturated blue/purple light beyond the left opening. It supplies a built interior with a localized warm practical against cool exterior light, rather than an evenly green-lit room. The Archive newsletter describes the film's zither encounter as occurring at night; matching this untimed still to that described scene is an inference, not a verified frame/timecode. At 240 by 156 pixels it supports broad lighting and flat-set treatment, not fine carpentry, measured colors, Qiushuang architecture, screen-bank spacing or a specific lamp-energy recipe.

items.title: The Enchanting Shadow — HKFA 3
items.reason: Lower-resolution alternate of the same zither composition adds no distinct required reference slot. The 240 by 156 Archive original is selected for Qiushuang only; this version is not counted separately.
